name: King David
overview: Scripture reveals King David as a man after God's own heart, chosen by God to lead His people and fulfill His will, as affirmed in Acts 13:22. The Psalms attributed to David highlight his deep reliance on the LORD as his rock, shepherd, light, and strength, expressing a profound trust in God's salvation and protection (Psalms 18:46; 23:1; 27:1; 144:1). These passages collectively underscore David's intimate relationship with God and his role in pointing forward to the ultimate salvation found in Christ.
